summary: Reviewed thread_send.py, threads.py, shared_objects.py diffs and new thread_shared_objects.py. Send: shared kinds reject any client attachment_key and non-dict meta; payload and fallback text are server-built via resolve_share (no client-supplied text or meta stored); threads flag then chat_shared_objects flag checked; ShareRejected maps to uniform not_allowed, other errors fail closed with nothing saved and a type-only log; membership/terms guards run before resolve. Read: thread_note_grant is deny-by-default, uses parameterized SQL, requires threads flag, non-deleted shared_note message, viewer and sender both live group members, viewer not suspended, no block pair, then the existing sender_may_share_note re-check at read time; all failures return None into the route's uniform 404 (no oracle). Chat grant behavior preserved by extraction. History output sanitised via clean_shared_note_meta. Note: tracked __pycache__ .pyc files appear in the diff; exclude from commit (hygiene, not a vulnerability). No source edits made.
